list: Our church picnic is Sunday, October 25 at 5:00 PM at Mark and Anne Deaton’s garage. They will provide soup and grilled cheese sandwiches. Please bring your favorite dessert.

Greenbriar Presbyterian Church is hosting a Women’s Fellowship meeting Saturday, November 7, beginning at 11:30 AM. Mary Lou Casada will be speaking, and Carmen Fields will provide special music. Please let Linda Baker know if you plan to attend.

fighterVerse.text: … My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
